title: John Whelan on Concert Window
content: Even better than canned video is free live streaming on your computer.Tonight at 8:00 p.m. USA Eastern time, you can watch a live concert by the great Irish accordion playerJohn Whelan.The show will be webcast fromClub Passimin Cambridge, Massachusetts viaConcert Window, a web startup co-founded by my sonDan Gurney.-----John Whelan's official websiteConcert Window / Whelan concert at 8:00Previously on GJ:John Whelan at Mary Kate'sIrish Music Party (with JWhelan)Dan's Squeezebox
